messages.subject: [IT] Document management system maintenance — Sat 8 Nov
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

The DMS and document comparison tools will be unavailable on Saturday 8 November from 07:00 to 13:00 for scheduled maintenance and a security patch. Please check out any documents you need before Friday close. Email will be unaffected.

Thanks,
IT Helpdesk
